texto: To order an informal interlocutor to NOT do something, the Italian uses in a fixed and mandatory way: **non + verbo en infinitivo**: **Non parlare!** (don't speak!), **Non aprire la porta!** (don't open the door!), **Non dimenticare il biglietto!** (don't forget the ticket!).
It is never said * non parli * nor * non parla * to ban something from «You».
In the informal negative imperative, the pronouns may go ahead of the infinitive or linked to their termination: **Non farlo!** = **Non lo fare!**; **Non ti preoccupare!** = **Non preoccuparti!**.

filas: I will not speak out loud! (Don't speak out loud!)
I learned the finestra! (Open the window!)

frases.it: Marco, devi stare attento con questo freddo invernale!
frases.es: ¡Marco, tienes que tener cuidado con este frío de invierno!
frases.en: Marco, you have to be careful with this winter cold!

frases.it: Sì, ho messo la giacca pesante e la sciarpa di lana.
frases.es: Sí, me he puesto la chaqueta gruesa y la bufanda de lana.
frases.en: Yeah, I put on the thick jacket and the wool scarf.

frases.it: Benissimo: non aprire le finestre prima di uscire e non correre.
frases.es: Muy bien: no abras las ventanas antes de salir y no corras.
frases.en: All right, don't open the windows before you go out and don't run.

frases.it: D'accordo, e per le medicine della farmacia?
frases.es: De acuerdo, ¿y para las medicinas de la farmacia?
frases.en: Okay, and for the drugs at the pharmacy?

frases.it: Non dimenticare la ricetta medica sul tavolo della cucina!
frases.es: ¡No olvides la receta médica sobre la mesa de la cocina!
frases.en: Don't forget the prescription on the kitchen table!

bloques.pregunta: How is the «Don't open the door.» ban made for a trusted person (you)?

opciones.explicacion: The negative imperative of second person singular is built with «non + infinitivo».
The present or simple imperative is not the regulatory form of prohibition for «tu».
It is the third person to be indicated.

bloques.pregunta: What structure follows the negative imperative of «tu» in Italian?

opciones.texto: La partícula «non» seguida obligatoriamente del verbo en infinitivo.
opciones.explicacion: It is a fixed rule: «non mangiare!», «non correre!», «non uscire!».

opciones.texto: La partícula «non» seguida del subjuntivo presente.
opciones.explicacion: The subjunctive is used for the formal necessity of courtesy (Lei).

opciones.texto: The «no» particle separated by a coma of the conjugated verb.
opciones.explicacion: The verbal denial is «non» and requires the infinitive for «tu».

bloques.frase: Se vuoi arrivare puntuale, ___ tempo prezioso stamattina.

opciones.explicacion: «tu»'s regular negative imperative structure: non + infinitive.
Form of an indication present with ordinary denial.

bloques.pregunta: What instruction does the sentence prescribe?
bloques.frase: Non dimenticare di spegnere le luci prima di uscire.

opciones.texto: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you leave.
opciones.explicacion: «Non dimenticare» makes a negative warning to avoid neglect.

opciones.texto: Turn on all the lights of the house immediately.
opciones.explicacion: He expressly asked not to forget to turn them off.

opciones.texto: Forget the keys inside the building.
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't mention keys, it's the lights.

bloques.pregunta: How can this phrase be formulated with an identical set of enclysis?
bloques.frase: Non ti preoccupare per l'esame: sei molto preparato.

opciones.texto: Non preoccuparti per l'esame: sei molto preparato.
opciones.explicacion: In the negative imperative the pronoun can be put before or postponed to the infinitive.
The pronoun must adhere to the end of the infinitive losing the -e.
It alters the person by mismoving to formal treatment.

bloques.frase: Non dimenticare il biglietto del treno

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct form of «Don't talk.» for a nearby person?

opciones.explicacion: «Non + infinitivo» is the only valid form of negative imperative for «tu».
It would be the formal courtesy formula addressed to «Lei».
Form of third person of present indicative.

intro: Learn to issue negative prohibitions and warnings to a trusted person with «non + infinitivo».
